title: Customer and item field availability via no-apply Personalize discovery
purpose: Open customer and item cards in UNIVERSAARL-DE and inspect available fields through Personalize without applying any layout, data or setup changes.
entryCriteria: TARGET-044B result exists and selects no-apply Personalize discovery.
TARGET-044 proved U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 card contexts are reachable read-only.
The Playwright route must confirm playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE before opening cards.
The test must be able to exit Personalize mode without applying any change.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central opens only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Customer and item card contexts are confirmed before Personalize mode.
Personalize mode is opened only for field availability discovery.
No add, move, hide, save or apply personalization action occurs.
Screenshots show the card context and Personalize mode/tooltips clearly enough for QA.
The result states which target fields are available, unavailable or still unclear.
The next step is either TARGET-045 controlled fit or a more specific alternative route.
stopConditions: Wrong instance or wrong company is visible.
A dialog asks to save/apply personalization.
A button/action would add, move, hide, edit, create, delete, post or preview.
Customer or item field values become editable unexpectedly.
Personalize mode cannot be closed without saving changes.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-044 showed read-only customer and item card contexts but no safe write route; TARGET-044B selected no-apply Personalize discovery before any field write.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: TARGET-045 remains premature until hidden or unavailable fields are mapped without applying personalization.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: It directly answers the hidden-field question without changing data or layout.
Write case only after exact field route and target values are proven.
O2C depends on customer/item posting, VAT and payment readiness.
Good fallback if Personalize does not expose the needed fields.
Vendor numbering remains parked and should not interrupt customer/item field discovery.

queueChangesMade: TARGET-044B completed as a local decision.
TARGET-044C selected before any field write.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It teaches Playwright and the book project how Business Central exposes hidden card fields while staying non-mutating.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not confuse available fields with correct setup values.
requiredPreparation: Close Personalize mode safely and document the exit route.
